description:
Advances: specled.spec_review

Review spec M1 (owner: spec defect). specled.spec_review.coverage_tab_bind_closure fuses ~8 independently-testable contracts (closure-line format, per-test-only 'Reached by tests' row, observed/approximate qualifier, file-level-proxy note, rollup badge, generated_at staleness, five degraded banners, no_tracer_manifest banner) verified via whole-file command tests — a regression in one clause can ship green at requirement granularity. Split into per-contract requirement ids with their own covering scenarios/tests.

comments.text:
CONTRACT (orchestrator-synthesized)

Spec co-change is AUTHORIZED and is the point of this ticket: you are editing .spec/specs/spec_review.spec.md to split requirement specled.spec_review.coverage_tab_bind_closure into per-contract requirement ids. This is not a scope violation.

Allowed touches:
- .spec/specs/spec_review.spec.md (the split)
- test/** (per-contract covering tests / tag adjustments so each new requirement id has its own scenario + test)
- .spec/decisions/** (optional short ADR only if the split changes architecture-level meaning)
- .spec/state.json, .spec/realization_hashes.json (tool-managed baselines; regenerate via documented command only)

Out of Scope (files): lib/** (no production code change), mix.exs, .github/**.

Out of Scope (intent): the union of the split requirements must be contract-preserving — cover everything the compound requirement asserted (closure-line format, per-test-only 'Reached by tests' row, observed/approximate qualifier, file-level-proxy note, rollup badge, generated_at staleness, five degraded banners, no_tracer_manifest banner). Do NOT weaken or drop any clause. Do NOT pre-implement the qualifier rendering change (that is specled_-q6l.2, blocked on this ticket).

Verification:
1. mix spec.check --no-run-commands green (structural validate + test-tag consistency).
2. Each split requirement id has its own scenario and a named covering test; flip verification stubs to execute: true where tests exist and run the flipped stubs.
3. Targeted test files green (change-scoped tier; no full suite).
